feature: Clean owner self-service onboarding proof
observed: Demo seeding defaults Off. The empty-registration integration exercises registration, DNS/email verification, approval and observation without handbook/maps/recipes; DNS/email transports are synthetic. The existing local registration has historical operator provisioning and seeded content.
recommendation: Repeat fresh empty onboarding through real owner DNS/email self-service before closing this case.

feature: Action button acknowledgement and bottom status
observed: Immediate busy/disabled state; duplicate activation executes once; bottom completion clears after three seconds, including when the originating button is removed.
recommendation: Keep the generic feedback wrapper on new asynchronous actions.

feature: HTML control coverage and cross-framework state compatibility
observed: Native radio/select/multiple-select/checkbox/datalist plus real React 18 and Angular 20 application state and independently persisted synthetic record readback pass. Stale control review is rejected.
recommendation: Support is bounded to the observed accessible controls; certify vendor widgets separately.

feature: Natural-language mixed dropdown and checkbox intent
observed: Real model chat understands Express plus Include gift wrap, presents Selected rather than internal true, supports Reject, and does not submit.
recommendation: Retain mixed-intent and negation regression coverage.

feature: Expand local fixture with tables and complex dynamic components
observed: Added and tested async picklist loading/no-match/error/duplicate-label rejection and recovery, dependent contact, table row selection/editing, sorting/filtering/pagination, dynamic rows, modal scope, numeric constraints and persisted table/multiselect values.
recommendation: This certifies the supported accessible fixture patterns. Vendor-specific virtualized grids or closed components still require their own adapter acceptance.

feature: Pairing gives stale generic errors and confusing self-inclusive member count
observed: Pairing is bilateral; counterpart count excludes this panel. Duplicate confirmation/revocation is idempotent and stale errors clear on successful action.
recommendation: Use the counterpart list and current presence instead of interpreting total membership as live peers.

feature: Disable pending action buttons and show progress state
observed: Shared asynchronous-action feedback suppresses repeated activation and exposes working/completed status. Background presence does not resurrect an old notice.
recommendation: Apply this shared path to newly introduced action controls.

feature: Browser refresh loses visible pairing and continuation
observed: Both actual browser tabs reload and rejoin their saved group using fresh endpoints. Ended private files and approvals are not restored.
recommendation: Reauthorize only after consent expiry/revocation or loss of browser proof.

feature: Inline Cancel or Reject in field review
observed: Field review includes Reject; Save review includes Cancel save. Rejecting private-file review retains the ready file. Both cancellation journeys independently assert zero host submissions.
recommendation: Keep fill approval and host Save approval separate.

feature: Summary-only no-write request incorrectly produces field-fill review
observed: Private summary-only prompt returns an answer with no field review or fill; synthetic host fields remain empty.
recommendation: Continue enforcing read-only intent before generating write proposals.

feature: Unified chat composer with paired-copilot at-mentions
observed: Handoffs use @recipient in the normal bottom composer and Send. Missing sharing consent is rejected; setup is limited to files, pairing/linking and consent.
recommendation: Use the shared composer for further delivery modes.

feature: Ended live task and stale online UI produce unrecoverable generic handoff refusal
observed: Reconnect, expiry/revocation and stale endpoint coverage pass; live offline workflow run 4062 reports COPILOT_RECIPIENT_OFFLINE without future delivery. Saved group remains.
recommendation: An uncertain host effect is never automatically replayed; inspect before retrying.

feature: Missing launcher on SDK bootstrap failure and absent loading/retry feedback
observed: Injected SDK download failure leaves host usable and visible Retry recovers without host reload on local/public. Explicit retry bypasses the browser cached failed module import.
recommendation: The eight-second attempt limit is a bound; injected recovery timings are not normal startup benchmarks.

feature: Confirmer-controlled pairing lifetime separate from visitor-session inactivity
observed: The confirmer chooses group name, hours/until-revoked and optional inactivity. Presence polling does not renew inactivity; persistence tests cover restart and expiry.
recommendation: Until revoked persists consent, not private task data or perpetual live authorization.

feature: Sender conversation trace for copilot handoffs
observed: Sender chat shows the instruction, selected context, recipient and delivery result/time; receiver gets the authorized private context.
recommendation: Private sender content clears when the task ends.

feature: Workflow setup must explain owner capability and stale paired-session prerequisites
observed: Workflow user authorization is distinct from website ownership. Independently linked single local target runs without peer pairing; another explicitly authorized same-owner target can join its saved group.
recommendation: Owner must enable workflow capability; visitor must explicitly link; Action Policies still apply. Public temporary capability was restored Off.

feature: Readable inspection results and downstream workflow use
observed: Run 4060 shows per-website fields/forms/navigation without entered values. Run 4063 inspect -> summarize passes the task-bound result handle: current form has zero visible fields, yet real LLM correctly reports all three previously observed required fields.
recommendation: Pass task-bound handles between steps before task cleanup; never store transaction text in durable generic workflow audit.

feature: Persistent reusable workflow copilot groups
observed: Runs 4059 and 4060 use the same saved group and website selection across both tab refreshes without new group/link IDs. Offline run 4062 fails clearly while retaining the group. No peer pairing dependency.
recommendation: Saved groups are reusable target authorizations; commands resolve eligible live endpoints on each run.

feature: Workflow instruction and copilot response in visitor chat history
observed: Both visitor panels show full incoming workflow instruction/progress and readable inspection result. Task end removes private instruction/data and keeps a structural completion trace.
recommendation: Review audit plus browser traces together; screenshot capture holds are excluded from latency measurements.

feature: Transaction extraction and citations
observed: Actual deployed parser/model: TXT, PDF, DOCX, PNG and JPEG, three correct fields and citations each. PDF/PNG Chrome uploads and summaries passed.
recommendation: Retain this synthetic corpus as a release gate; additional languages/handwriting are unsupported.

feature: Reviewed fill and independent Save proof
observed: PDF and PNG: fresh Customer field review, explicit fill, separate synthetic Save; exact returned record UUID and three values independently read back.
recommendation: Keep business-save readback host-specific. Observed fields alone never prove persistence.

feature: Requested form, missing/conflicting fields
observed: Both browser runs navigated from Customer to Note then freshly inspected/filled. Unit cases reject invented values, missing/conflicting/repeated labels.
recommendation: Expand custom-control coverage per host before advertising support.

feature: Private upload and document boundary
observed: Capability separation, extension/MIME/signature/binary/size limits and instruction rejection pass. No private upload publishes shared sources.
recommendation: Keep supported formats explicit; add separate acceptance before adding languages/file types.

feature: Anonymous local/public bilateral pairing
observed: Anonymous live Chrome panels on loopback Customer and public flolah.cloud MCP Universe paired with bilateral confirmation; each panel displayed the other exact origin.
recommendation: Use fresh pairing codes and current preview authorization for future releases; pairing remains user consent rather than device attestation.

feature: Pairing and identity isolation
observed: Wrong owner, expiry/reuse, foreign instance/session, conflicting user links and unrelated group tests pass.
recommendation: Pairing is explicit user consent, not proof of a single physical device.

feature: Private handoff to public destination form
observed: Sharing without consent rejected; with consent, private integration passages reached the public panel. Real model proposed Inventory API and stdio from the file. Controls remained blank until approval, then both values were independently observed; no public submission.
recommendation: Keep destination inspection and review; never interpret filled controls as a saved business record. Future website fixtures must supply their own observed controls.

feature: Signed-in workflow discovery and editor
observed: Real signed-in editor saved direct targets, website selection and stable group; real runs 4058/4059/4060 completed without a peer pair.
recommendation: Keep owner policy and entitled workflow-user binding separate.

feature: Website selection and captured fanout
observed: Selected websites/all-active exact snapshot; missing selected website, unrelated groups/new arrivals, busy tabs and duplicate operations tested.
recommendation: Retain runtime snapshot preflight; never queue for future visitors.

feature: Policy modes, approvals and effects
observed: Actual runner passes autonomous/prohibited/exact approval fanout, maxUses override exhaustion and single-use grants. Per-effect revalidation/binding tests pass. Updated real-runner integration also asserts offline error propagation; live browser workflows in this session are read-only.
recommendation: Complete signed-in browser workflow fill and owner-bound native Save with independent host readback.

feature: Disconnect, fail-fast and no replay
observed: Real live target disconnect causes run 4062 to fail with COPILOT_RECIPIENT_OFFLINE. Group remains; runner regression checks safe error propagation and duplicate/lost-command paths.
recommendation: No offline queue or replacement visitor. A new run is required after reconnect.

feature: Task deletion and checkpoint privacy
observed: End/expiry/restart/revocation tests pass; live canary absent SQLite rows and consistent checkpoint; raw objects ciphertext only; ending task leaves zero bytes/backlog. Both panel logs/reviews/files clear. Public recipient shows shared-file status without unauthorized Remove control; End task clears both cross-origin panels.
recommendation: Verify final zero private metrics after each release and preserve encrypted-object/key separation.

feature: Workflow downstream privacy
observed: Task-only result handles and real runner persisted context/step canary checks pass; ordinary private chat never enters durable history. Run 4063 now proves actual chained LLM consumption of authorized private handles before cleanup.
recommendation: Broaden downstream node/template/tool/Kanban/telemetry adversarial matrix; document actual upstream provider retention.

feature: 25 websites / 25 users capacity
observed: Fresh H-image isolated 25-website/25-user capacity result is linked. It includes 50 authenticated sockets, two real Python parsers and 250 HTTP samples, without production mounts.
recommendation: Short synthetic pilot excludes full concurrent model/OCR/provider latency, soak and multi-coordinator HA. Measure these before scaling beyond the pilot.

recommendation: Approved preview expires at 15:17 Singapore on 18 October 2026. Public browser acceptance remains no-login/no-submit.
